title: Compatibility Check smoke eval
objective: Task-specific eval for the Compatibility Check craftbook: a 1.20-era boat-diamond datapack (pack_format 15, plural folder names) checked against 1.21.5 and 1.20.6 using the house version notes — a Version/Status matrix, every break named with its file and fix, and an ordered upgrade path.
prompt: does our boat-diamond pack still work on 1.21.5? and what about 1.20.6? check compatability and write it up

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for compat-check. The datapack under test sits in the workspace: pack.mcmeta (currently pack_format 15) and the boatpack content under data/ using the pre-1.21 plural folder names. The house version notes at notes/format-versions.md carry the pack_format table and the 1.21 folder-rename rule. Findings go to notes/checks.md and the matrix report to report.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Use the Compatibility Check craftbook/template, check the pack against 1.21.5 and 1.20.6 using only the version notes and the pack's own files, and write report.md with a Version/Status matrix, per-break fixes, and an ordered upgrade path. Claims trace to the notes or the files — anything the notes do not cover is marked unverified, never guessed.

files.content:
# Datapack format numbers (house notes)

| Game version | pack_format |
| --- | --- |
| 1.20 | 15 |
| 1.20.6 | 41 |
| 1.21 | 48 |
| 1.21.5 | 71 |

Folder names: since 1.21 the data folder names are singular - function,
recipe, advancement, loot_table, and tags/function. Before 1.21 they were
plural - functions, recipes, advancements, loot_tables, tags/functions.
A pack using the old plural names loads on 1.21+ but its content silently
never fires.

success.summary: report.md answers at a glance: a Version/Status matrix covering both asked versions, the pack_format mismatches named with the numbers from the notes, the 1.21 folder renames caught as breaks with exact files, and an ordered upgrade path.

checks.label: every game version cited comes from the version notes

checks.rubric: Each verdict traces to the version notes or the pack's actual files (pack_format 15 versus the required 71 and 41; the plural functions/advancements folders breaking on 1.21+), fixes name the exact file and change, the upgrade path is ordered with a test step per fix, and nothing outside the notes is asserted with confidence.
checks.label: grounded verdicts and concrete fixes

axes.name: thoroughness
axes.description: Both asked versions get real verdicts; format number and folder names are both checked.

axes.name: precision
axes.description: Breaks name the exact file and the exact expected value or name.

axes.name: upgrade-guidance
axes.description: The fixes are ordered into a path with a test step per change.

axes.name: honesty
axes.description: Anything beyond the notes is marked unverified, never asserted from memory.
